sentences.en: While employed at the bank, he taught economics at college.
sentences.zh: 在银行工作期间，他还在大学教经济学。

sentences.en: If he had been honest, I would have employed him.
sentences.zh: 如果他诚实的话，我会雇用他的。

sentences.en: If he had been honest, they would have employed him.
sentences.zh: 如果他诚实的话，他们会雇用他的。

senses.zh: 使用，采用；雇用；使忙于，使从事于
